core_obligations: Set up the two spectral sequences (proof lines 17995-18002): consider E_2^{p,q} = R^p f_*H^q(E) and E'_2^{p,q} = R^p f'_*(g')^{-1}H^q(E) converging to R^n f_*E and R^n f'_*(g')^{-1}E respectively.

Identify the entries (proof lines 18003-18007): combining the smooth base change theorem with the base change lemma for a limit of smooth schemes gives g^{-1}R^p f_*H^q(E) = R^p f'_*(g')^{-1}H^q(E) for all p, q.
Conclude (proof lines 18008-18011): the identification of all the entries of the two spectral sequences makes the abutments isomorphic, which is the asserted base change identity for the complex E.
proof_roadmap: Write the two hypercohomology spectral sequences for f and f'.
Use smooth base change plus base change along the limit to identify their E_2 entries.
Conclude the identification of the abutments.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes base change for a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism after base change to a directed limit of smooth schemes, for complexes whose coefficient stalks are torsion of invertible orders (statement lines 17974-17992). The proof (proof lines 17994-18011) compares the two spectral sequences of the complex, identifies their E_2 entries by smooth base change together with the limit case, and concludes for the abutments. H2: one spectral sequence comparison.
